meta.title: Toolbox
meta.description: Adds a Toolbox entry to the left sidebar of the DSH Web GUI. The panel shows a card grid; click a card to open its tool. Currently four tools ship: a JSON formatter, which pretty-prints JSON and reports the exact position of a syntax error; an XML formatter, which indents XML and reports the exact position of a syntax error; a JSON comparison, which puts two JSON documents side by side and lists every way they differ, each with its path; and an XML comparison, which does the same for two XML documents. Everything runs in this browser — no text leaves your machine — and nothing is stored between visits. Removing the plugin removes the entry and its tools.
